capabilities: Quiz decks and log wrong answers
Track progress across decks in a grid
disambiguation: Not a general language-learning framework; it is a fixed set of English vocabulary decks with Chinese glosses.
extras: Paid plugin: 7-day full-featured trial, then ¥49.9 one-time with lifetime updates, bought via WeChat 452026075. Runs offline; the only network use is speaking through the system TTS. Example sentences come from Tatoeba (CC-BY 2.0 FR).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to drill English vocabulary in decks, quiz yourself and revisit the words you got wrong.
summary: English vocabulary trainer with 250 decks of 5000 words, phonetics, Chinese glosses, example sentences, deck quizzes and a mistake notebook.
